title: HostChangeRequest
description: Structured declaration of proposed host-side changes. Generated by task-runner, reviewed by main agent, executed by broker. Must be declarative, reviewable, and broker-oriented. Must NOT contain shell snippets or direct commands.

task_id.description: Task identifier matching the parent summary.json

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this request was generated

sequence.description: Execution order (1-based). Ops with the same sequence can run in parallel.

action.description: Broker action name. Must be one of the 8 registered host-ops actions.

inputs.description: Action-specific inputs matching the broker action's input schema

justification.description: Why this action is needed, for main agent review

rollback_note.description: What to do if this action fails

requested_host_ops.description: Ordered list of broker actions to execute

requires_operator_approval.description: True if human operator must review before main agent forwards to broker. Always true for security boundary changes, cost-incurring changes, and irreversible changes.

pre_conditions.description: Conditions that must be verified before execution (e.g. 'gateway is healthy', 'no active sessions')

forbidden_actions.description: Actions explicitly NOT requested (direct shell, systemd override, manual config edit, etc.)

evidence_refs.description: Evidence supporting why these changes are needed. Must point to repo files, outputs, logs, or authoritative docs.

handoff.description: Instructions for main agent: what to verify after execution, what to report to operator

risk_level.description: low: reversible, no service impact. medium: brief service disruption, snapshot-recoverable. high: security boundary or irreversible change.
